## Local-first / safety expectations

- [ ] No telemetry.
- [ ] No cloud calls by default.
- [ ] No external update checks or GitHub/API lookups.
- [ ] No model weights, audit logs, `target/` artifacts, or `local-evidence/` files committed.
- [ ] Aethra remains fixture-backed by default where relevant.
- [ ] No production compliance, ESG certification, certified reporting, or production readiness claims.
